Hi all —

Thanks for the quick review, Logan. Answers below and I've attached the countersigned NDA and an updated SOW (Blindspot_SOW_v1.3.pdf) that includes a revised billing contact and our standard evidence handling clause.

- Start window: Earliest we can start is the week of May 10. We can split the engagement across weeks (2 external / 3 internal) — we recommend a full internal week when possible, but split is fine.
- Rules of engagement: We include a read-only/non-destructive testing default for internal API endpoints; destructive testing is only performed with explicit written approval and a separate addendum.
- Evidence handling: Findings and evidence are stored in our encrypted portal (AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit). Retention is 90 days by default; we can extend or provide immediate sanitization on request. Audit logs for access to the portal are available on request.
- Billing/PO: Please route purchasing questions to your procurement team; the SOW now lists a billing contact at Blindspot (billing@blindspotsec.com).

Attachments: Blindspot_SOW_v1.3.pdf (PDF, 179KB), NDA_signed.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Happy to hop on a 30-min kickoff to walk through access patterns and timeboxes. Proposed times: Tue May 11 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed May 12 14:00-14:30 PT.

Best,
Ellen

Hi Ellen —

Thanks for the updates and countersigned NDA. A couple of items the Security team needs clarified before we finalize scheduling: 

1) Evidence access: Who on the Blindspot side will have permanent access to the portal? We need a named list and their roles.
2) Data minimization: We want confirmation that you will not retain any customer PII beyond encrypted screenshots necessary for reproducing findings; any sensitive artifacts should be redacted on delivery unless explicitly needed.
3) Scope exclusions: Please confirm that CI/CD pipelines and production database write endpoints are out of scope unless we specifically add them in writing.

Also, Procurement — can you confirm Redwood's PO timeline? We need a PO issued at least 7 business days prior to the start date to ensure vendor onboarding and firewall exceptions are arranged. Ellen, we can share a PO number as soon as Procurement confirms.

If that all looks OK, Logan — I'm good with the proposed May 11 kickoff (10:00 PT). Ellen, please share a DocuSign link for the updated SOW so Procurement can attach the signed docs to the PO.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security Operations | Redwood Inference
